sensitive_attribute_context.transparency_note: The sensitive attribute 'sex' was excluded from model training features to prevent direct demographic decisioning.

clinical_safety.causality_disclaimer: SHAP values quantify statistical feature influence within this specific machine learning model. They do not establish biological or clinical causality.
clinical_safety.fairness_vs_explainability: High or low SHAP importance for a demographic attribute does not prove or disprove algorithmic bias. Fairness must be audited through validated group-level disparity metrics (DPD, DIR, Equalized Odds, Underdiagnosis FNR).
